The '''Vis district''' was an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that contained [[Skybridge/Legends|skybridges]]. It shared its name<ref name="Endgame" /> with the Naboo [[City/Legends|city]] [[Vis/Legends|Vis]] and [[Lake Vis]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="Endgame" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was sent to aid the invaders.<ref name="Endgame" />

[[Gender/Legends|He]] speculated that the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|escaped]] [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of Naboo would make her return to [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] by leading her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escort and infiltration teams on a path through the eastern fork of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] and the skybridges of the Vis district. Maul knew that a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] with the Jedi along that route would be uncontrollable and that he would have to try to [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|fight]] them before they left the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].<ref name="Endgame" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vis district was mentioned in "[[End Game]]," a short story written by [[James Luceno]] and published in the [[2012]] rerelease of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]].<ref name="Endgame" />
